caption:
Different bases? Make them match first.

8 = 2³ and 16 = 2⁴. Distribute the exponents on both sides, then set them equal.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: 8 and 16 are both powers of 2. That's the whole trick.

youtube.title: SAT Exponential Equation: Rewrite With a Common Base
youtube.description: Rewrite both sides with base 2, then set the exponents equal. SAT-style practice question (original).
